Without the P1-0 smoke block: 1039 runs, 129.9 GPU-h, 10.39 GB.

Every figure is computed from its own run count (exact, then rounded half up: GPU-h to 0.1, GB to 0.01); no figure is a sum of rounded values, so a column need not add up to its rounded total. The free-disk prerequisite of a phase is the disk of the runs that remain from that phase on plus the runner floor of 6 GiB, rounded up to 0.1 GiB.

Route lengths (XML polyline): test 4.61 km, training 4.49 km.
